0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4, 6th in the East) visit the Cavaliers (5-4, 2nd in the Central) for New York's ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Knicks on a two-game winning streak but just 1-2 on the road. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury, while Cleveland will be without Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won 2-1 against Cleveland in 2025-26 and won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 130-93 win in Cleveland on May 25.
